summary: Recursive traversal of a dynamics BVH node chain. For each node: runs LinkedListNodeTraversal on the node, iterates the four child slots beginning at this+0x4C recursing into every non-null child, then advances to the next node via the sibling pointer at this+0x5C and repeats until the sibling chain ends. Returns the final sibling pointer (null when the chain terminates). Called by TriangleMeshAdjacencyBuilder (004493a0); structurally a twin of CollisionTreeTraversal (00448da0) per the cluster prelabel.

local_names.v2: pointer to the first child slot at this+0x4C

operations.description: Outer loop walks the sibling chain: each iteration processes the current node, then reads the next node pointer from this+0x5C and repeats while it is non-null
LinkedListNodeTraversal(this) processes the linked-list payload of the current node at the start of each visit
Inner do-while loop iterates the four consecutive child slots beginning at this+0x4C (this+19 dwords), decrementing the counter from 4 to 0
A child slot is recursed into only when its pointer is non-null
Recursive call to DynamicsBVHNodeRecursiveTraversal for each non-null child slot
Advance the traversal to the next node by reassigning this = this[0x5C] after all four child slots are processed
Returns the last next-node pointer read (null when the sibling chain ends, terminating the recursion level)
The traversal is entered from TriangleMeshAdjacencyBuilder (004493a0)
